overview: Chef Brian Turner takes celebrities back to their youths using the power of food.
title: My Life on a Plate

overview: Two survivors. Two conflicting stories. Only one can be true. When a badly wounded woman is airlifted to safety, she tells police a terrifying story: their group of friends fell under the psychopathic control of a charismatic outsider, leading to manipulation and psychological torture, and death. But just as the case appears closed, an unpredictable twist shatters everything — one of the supposed victims is still alive, and her account of what happened in the wilderness is utterly different.
title: Sarek

overview: Eight men believe they are participating in a reality TV show, while their partners secretly test their loyalty and relationship skills. Love, comedy, and drama collide in a luxury villa and the "Bro Zone."
title: Bad Boyfriends

overview: The series focuses on Asao Atsuko, who works at a bento shop, and her partner, patent attorney Iwaki Kohei. Despite being university sweethearts who have comfortably lived together for 12 years, their routine is disrupted when Kohei has a one-time affair with his colleague Yuko. This explores their struggles with emotional drifting, hesitation, and the nature of "family".
title: Niko Tama

overview: An Exclusive, insiders look at the hottest residential properties in the Chicagoland market.
title: Open House Chicago

overview: Salt Lick Session presents: "Songs of U.S.", a new performance and conversation series bringing together artists from across the American musical landscape to reinterpret songs that have shaped the country's cultural identity — and to ask what belongs in the American songbook today.
title: Songs of U.S.

overview: Zhao Yanqing, the heir to a wealthy family, falls in love at first sight with Jiang Li, the daughter of his family's driver, after she drives him home one evening. He's helping her family discreetly. She's a fighter who won't accept help easily. Between them: an eight year age gap, social gap - the daughter of the help? It's a huge class difference Aware of the gulf between their social standing, Jiang Li hesitates. For years. Fate brings them together once more at the 404 Pub.
title: 404: The Camellia Will Bloom

overview: The Kelly File is an American news television program hosted by journalist and former attorney Megyn Kelly on the Fox News Channel. The program is a spinoff of The O'Reilly Factor, and focuses on late-breaking stories in a live format as well as news analysis and in-depth investigative reports interspersed with newsmaker interviews. The program airs Monday through Friday live from 9:00 pm – 10:00 pm ET. It is rebroadcast from 12:00 am – 1:00 am ET, however in the event of a breaking news story, the 12:00 am rebroadcast is replaced with an additional live show. A pre-recorded Sunday edition also airs, featuring the top story of the week.
title: The Kelly File

overview: After waking from a four-year coma and learning that her ex-husband had plotted her murder, Nozomi takes on a new identity and seeks revenge.
title: Deep Revenge

overview: Set against the backdrop of Republican-era Shanghai, Xu Yanzhen, an orphaned painter with extraordinary artistic talent, unexpectedly crosses paths with Jiang Xinyu, the chief accountant of Ronghui Bank, who has been framed and pushed into a desperate situation. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two soon uncover a scheme to sell a priceless national treasure painting to foreign buyers at a bargain price. Using her remarkable forgery skills, Xu Yanzhen creates a flawless replica, allowing them to secretly swap the original masterpiece. As powerful forces close in from every side, Xu Yanzhen and Jiang Xinyu navigate a web of deception and danger with courage and ingenuity. Together, they overcome one peril after another, unravel hidden conspiracies, and fight to protect their country's cultural heritage.
title: Where Colors Dream

overview: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.
title: Muthassi

overview: Emma and Florence, 14-year-old twins, one with black skin and the other white, must redefine their identity after the tragic death of a young black woman in their neighborhood.
title: Jumelles

overview: In a psychiatric hospital overseas in Country M, the most dangerous patient, Xiao Mu Chen, passes his 144th mental evaluation and is finally discharged. But no one knows that his condition has never truly improved-he still sees the phantom of his fiancée, Jin Zhao Xi, whispering in his ear, urging him to take bloody revenge. Four years ago, on the day he had planned to propose, Jin Zhao Xi was brutally murdered. He arrived too late, only to see the four culprits walking away, laughing. Now, at last free, he begins the revenge he has long prepared for...
title: The Dark Side of the Sun

overview: Live-action anthology TV drama series adapting stories from Junji Ito's "Masterpiece Collection."
title: Strange — Junji Ito's Strange Stories for Sleepless Nights

overview: They're back, but this time, at a farm! The three men's chaotic journey to adjust to animal farm life begins! The Lee Kwang-soo, Kim Woo-bin, Doh Kyung-soo trio arrives In the peaceful farm that sits on the lush, green pastures of Jeju. This time, they're kicking off a brand-new life alongside dozens of cows. From feeding the cows at the crack of dawn, checking on the fences, and handling all sorts of tasks popping up endlessly, they are suddenly hit with an unexpected crisis. Will the trio manage to keep the peace and survive the farm? A farm-tastic farmstay of the three besties, where laughter, friendship, and the beautiful nature of Jeju all mix and mingle.
title: GBRB: Farm Operation - Go Go Farm

overview: From the age of five, Lu Ying clung to Jin Bei Zhou like a shadow, even until they married. Jin Bei Zhou would rather believe the world turned upside down than for Lu Ying to leave him. But a sudden kidnapping made Lu Ying realize that no one can live without the other. In their third year of marriage, Lu Ying filed for divorce. But Jin Bei Zhou refused to let go,crushing his pride and begging her with bloodshot eyes not to leave. It turned out that the person they couldn't live without was Jin Bei Zhou.
title: The Night Mist Scorches

overview: Rama and Umesh are a happy couple with a good home, a loving family and well-settled corporate jobs. They've passed all the big hurdles of a relationship - romantic 20s, long marriage, setting up a home and finally.
title: Hey Kay Navin?

overview: Song Huai Chuan, a member of the Nuwa clan, is tricked into forming a contract with Xu Sui An, who suffers from a terminal illness. He initially intends to use marriage as a cover to stabilize his company and uncover the truth behind his mother's death; Xu Sui An, in turn, can be cured of her illness using the bloodline of the Nuwa clan. Both get what they want, but in theprocess of investigating the truth, Song Huai Chuan discovers that Xu Sui An seems to have a complex relationship with his mother, and that she is not a simple human girl, but a shrouded-in-mystery figure.
title: Sui Sui Huai An

overview: The new series is a Maria & Mayer production, with project direction by António Borges Correia and support from ICA. The story features a cast composed of big names in Portuguese fiction, such as Dalila Carmo, Diogo Infante, Inês Castel-Branco, José Condessa, Sara Barradas, and São José Lapa.
title: A Filha

overview: Qiao Yuan is forced into marriage with Fu Tingzhou after her older sister runs away from the wedding. To the outside world, this looks like a sudden replacement marriage, but for Qiao Yuan it is much more dangerous emotionally — because Fu Tingzhou is the man she has secretly loved for ten years. After marriage, she becomes his most familiar stranger at home and his most reliable partner at work. Their relationship starts with obligation, distance, and old feelings hidden under professionalism, but the longer they stay beside each other, the harder it becomes to pretend this marriage is only an arrangement.
title: Newlywed Addiction

overview: Facing execution, a compromised capital-city spy named Ivan Vyhovsky is forced to accept a seemingly doomed assignment. Instead of the gallows, a perilous mission awaits him—one that transforms the former agent into a fearless Cossack leader.
title: Пригоди козака Виговського

overview: Disguise might be able to hide the truth, but it can never hide the feelings born within the heart. When a female bodyguard must protect a mischievous young lady who is the light of her life - how will this love story end?
title: My Lady's Bodyguard

overview: Adapted from "Sister's Heist" in Yan Yan Story. Xia Yan and Fang Yun, two best friends, accidentally transmigrate into a novel. Xia Yan becomes the obsessed wife of the cunning second male lead, Gu Bochuan, while Fang Yun is forced into the role of stand-in lover for the dangerous yandere antagonist, Gu Wang. On the surface, they play their parts as lovelorn captives, but behind closed doors, they are secretly indulging in every luxury their lavish, high-society lives afford. When the "white moonlight" female lead, Shen Mianmian, returns, the two decide to "fake their deaths" and escape to avoid being swept into the tragic plot of the original story…
title: Sisters' Heist

overview: The story follows a dedicated surgeon and a successful hotel entrepreneur who have known each other since their school days. Their relationship has always existed somewhere between attraction and rivalry. Everything changed after one particular night, leaving unanswered questions that one of them desperately tries to forget while the other refuses to let go. Now, fate continues bringing them together. Between hospital corridors and luxury hotel halls, both women struggle to navigate unresolved emotions, professional responsibilities, and feelings they have carried for years.
title: Did You Know

overview: Addicted To Marriage is centered around an arranged or contract-style marriage deal, and explores how the protagonists transition from a strict agreement to developing genuine affection.
title: Addicted To Marriage

overview: Nayul was at her breaking point. Between the crushing workload and her detestable boss, Kwon Sijin-a man who perfected the art of trampling on dignity-she'd had enough. At 11 PM on a Friday, driven by pure rage, she stormed into his office. There, time froze. Nayul stood paralyzed, having caught her "perfect" yet perverted boss in the middle of a private, lewd act during overtime.
title: Quiet in the Office!

overview: In this game of love, Nan Ye Jue is the conqueror, the brutal plunderer. He gives Rong En ten days to compromise, then gradually closes in, completely destroying Rong En's once-normal life. The superior bows to love, but Rong En always remembers the pain he inflicted. Her unwavering clarity drives Nan Ye Jue ever more mad, and he's determined to keep her by his side at all costs.
title: Hide One's Love

overview: Amidst the mermaid civil war, the Empress Princess Yun Ling —the heir with a sacred mission—stripped of her powers and exiled her to the mortal realm. Four merfolk closely tied to Yun Ling transformed into a doctor, a celebrity, a CEO, and a mafia boss to infiltrate the human world. Their quest: Find Yun Ling, uncover why she vanished... and confront her mortal incarnation, Xia Shi Yue, in a story of fire and tides.
title: Mermaid Husband

overview: After catching her fiancé cheating with her stepsister and being thrown out by her own father, Wen Qiansu's life falls apart. On a rainy night, she meets the mysterious Mr. Huo, a man rumored to be cold and unhinged—but who treats her with unexpected kindness. As their relationship grows, Qiansu remains unaware that Mr. Huo has loved her for years and has been given a second chance at life, hiding the dark obsession that once led him to imprison her as he tries to protect her and rewrite their fate.
title: The Captive Rose

overview: Meng Yu was fostered away from home from a young age. Her biological parents doted on their adopted daughter, Meng Huan, and only used her. After breaking up with her ex-boyfriend, she was forced to accept her family's arrangement to marry Fu Qingshao, the heir to the Fu Group. He needed a loveless, unconditional wife to avoid suspicion, while she needed the status of Mrs. Fu to live a stable life and earn money to treat her adoptive mother's illness. The two, each getting what they wanted, signed a contract and hastily got married.
title: Forever Love

overview: When Isogai realizes that Hinata has the ability to spot murderers, he asks her to help him find the serial killer who murdered his fiancée, Azusa Kawada.
title: Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer

overview: Jiang Jiao was sold by the Jiang family into a marriage alliance with Fu Ran. At their first meeting, Fu Ran tried to force her into a divorce and even resorted to violence. Though she appeared gentle and obedient, Jiang Jiao was in fact ruthless, pretending to be compliant while secretly plotting revenge against both the Jiang family and the Lu family, stirring up storms in the business world.
title: Burning Beauty

overview: Luo Jia discovers that Cheng Jin, the new transfer from orthopedics, is the very man she had a one-night stand with the night before. Cheng Jin switches seamlessly between domineering and puppy-like, successfully winning Luo Jia's heart. Just as their romance grows sweet, Luo Jia learns that Cheng Jin only approached her to get revenge on his ex-girlfriend. Heartbroken, she returns to Yu City. Unexpectedly, Cheng Jin follows her there, beginning his desperate "wife-chasing crematorium" journey.
title: Fen Shou Hou, Cheng Yi Sheng Ku Chu Bi Ti Pao

overview: Die Realitystar Academy, the reality competition centers on a ruthless talent factory where 18 undiscovered hopefuls cram for fame. Guided by prominent reality figures, the candidates must survive grueling tasks and daily drama to prove they have what it takes to be the next big reality TV main character.
title: Die Realitystar Academy

overview: Crossroad follows a clash of personalities and ideals within the high-pressure environment of Yokohama Bay Hospital.
title: Crossroad

overview: After serving a stint in prison, single mom Gu Xing Wan is released and struggles to find a job in the law field. She ends up as the legal assistant to her ex-boyfriend, Attorney Yan, who can't understand why she wouldn't let him wait for her 5 years ago.
title: First Love Returns

overview: In her previous life, Jiang Song Chu died in an earthquake. The husband she had never truly cared about, Zhou Qi An, instead chose to quietly watch over her until the end. Given a second chance at life, Jiang Song Chu returns to four years earlier, to the time when she and Zhou Qi An had been married for just one year through a whirlwind marriage. This time, she decisively cuts ties with the charming but shallow Lin Tian and reunites with Zhou Qi An. Jiang Song Chu soon confirms that Zhou Qi An has not been reborn like she has. Armed with the experiences of her previous life, she quickly realizes that beneath Zhou Qi An's serious and proper exterior as a university professor lies feelings for her that he has harbored for a long time. However, his overly restrained and principled nature was precisely why she noticed nothing in her last life. Determined not to repeat her regrets, Jiang Song Chu makes up her mind: in this life, she will take the initiative, draw closer to Zhou Qi An, and win his heart.
title: Professor Zhou Was the First to Fall in Love

overview: After successfully confessing her love, 18-year-old girl Xu Chu Nian traveled through time and space to become a 24-year-old abandoned wife of a wealthy family. Faced with her indifferent husband, Jiang Huai Xu, and her mute daughter, Zhu Zhu, she was determined to save everything. When strange memories and men in black appeared frequently, she discovered that the world was actually set in a novel! Xu Nian Chu broke free from control and fought against the plot. She could only write her own life!
title: Nian Nian Ru Huai

overview: Three years ago, to save her critically ill grandmother, Gu Xingwan unilaterally blocked her boyfriend Ji Yan, who was studying abroad, and got together with Fu Sihan. Three years later, when she accompanied Fu Sihan to visit his parents, she unexpectedly encountered Ji Yan, who had been searching for her for three years. Ji Yan couldn't accept reality and began to relentlessly pursue Gu Xingwan. At the same time, Fu Sihan's favoritism completely broke Gu Xingwan's heart, and she resolutely broke up with Fu Sihan, bringing a new turning point to their relationship.
title: Double Blade

overview: Follow three lifelong friends as they leave their pasts behind for the sun-drenched shores of Bodrum—a place of escape, reckoning, and unexpected rebirth.
title: Turquoise Summer

overview: Dia a Dia com Goldenboy, hosted by streamer and presenter Felipe Goldenboy, serves up behind-the-scenes moments and pop culture commentary directly from the network's studios.
title: Dia a Dia com Goldenboy

overview: For the 1994 World Cup, Germany entered as the favorite and defending champion, but was eliminated in the quarterfinals. Internal conflicts, media campaigns, and public criticism of coach Berti Vogts led the so-called "eleven friends" – players like Lothar Matthäus, Jürgen Klinsmann, Stefan Effenberg, Bodo Illgner, and Matthias Sammer – to maneuver themselves into a collective nightmare within just a few weeks. This documentary takes a behind-the-scenes look at Germany's memorable World Cup and shows how one of the strongest German teams of all time spectacularly failed.
title: WM 1994 – Elf Helden, ein Albtraum

overview: Four boys enter a music contest, hoping to win money for gaming equipment. But they are surprised when they do so well that they become a popular boy band.
title: BaseBoys

overview: Kristina and Albina have a lot of secrets and tricks that turn things in the kitchen into a fun holiday. Together with them, viewers will learn how to create a real branch of a restaurant at home, where not only delicious, but also very beautiful food is served.
title: Два с половиной повара

overview: Ye Ji enters a 19+ dating show with a huge cash prize for her boyfriend, who lost everything. The only way to win the 1.9 billion prize is to spend the night with another man. There, she meets Jae Hyeon, her first love, and Do Hyeok, the ex-husband she broke up with after an affair. Between true love, the 1.9 billion prize, and her own desires—what will Ye Ji choose?
title: Romantic Island

overview: A gripping family drama and entrepreneurial fable, set in a post-war Paris fashion house. It exposes the grit behind the glamour of a rising business, spearheaded by two clashing brothers. The atelier staff survived one war, but others loom; rivalries and romances pitting family against family, protégés against mentors, the past against the future.
title: The Collection

overview: For a series of 54 specials and shows, Martin would periodically "roast" a celebrity. These roasts were patterned after the roasts held at the New York Friars' Club in New York City. The format would have the celebrity guest seated at a banquet table, and one by one the guest of honor was affectionately chided or insulted about his career by his fellow celebrity friends.
title: The Dean Martin Celebrity Roast

overview: Eray, a senior manager in a bank, does not get the promotion he looks up to. As his moral compass is put to test, he finds himself having to choose between integrity and ambition: Will he get the position he deserves by any means necessary?
title: Yankı Görünmez El

overview: Set in a fictional ancient empire, the dark sorcery of the Mijiang people creates an undead monster army that invades the Dasheng realm, leading to the capital's fall and the emperor's capture. Fang Sun, a Mijiang orphan with eagle-like vision, and Princess Xiao Qing of Dasheng form an alliance. Trapped in a besieged city amid political intrigue and hordes of monsters, they lead soldiers and civilians in a desperate last stand with cold weapons and muskets, fighting both the undead horde and traitors to save their nation. Blending Eastern political intrigue, doomsday survival, and superhuman awakening, it features dark, intense visuals and a fast-paced plot.
title: Dynasty of the Undead: Mutate

overview: Under the impression that they are entering a standard 35-day group challenge at dawn, the survivalists instead begin their insertion adrift at sea overnight. With emergency flares shooting overhead, the survivalists must grab whatever limited resources they can before making their way ashore. Divided into four groups of three, the survivalists are stranded on a mysterious and isolated island on the lost coast of the Philippines, often described as the "Bermuda Triangle of Southeast Asia," due to its history of past shipwrecks and unexplained disappearances. The terrain offers both opportunities and risk, with a dense, resource-rich jungle that contains the remnants of those who came before. Teams work together to build shelters and tools from the wreckage, including a 300-foot primitive water aqueduct. In the surrounding seas, survivalists must contend with tiger and hammerhead sharks, stingrays, sea snakes and box jellyfish whose venom contains one of the ocean's most lethal toxins. Far removed from civilization and with no food, no fresh water and no clothing, the survivalists must adapt quickly, relying not only on their individual skills but also on their ability to innovate and salvage whatever they can from the environment. With each team receiving only one piece of the challenge map, they must track down the others and combine pieces to rescue themselves from the island on Day 35.
title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked

overview: After an injury ends his NBA dreams, Myron Bolitar reinvents himself as a sports agent - using charm, smarts, and a ruthless partner to navigate the high-stakes and dirty world of sports, where saving his clients often means risking himself.
title: Harlan Coben's Myron Bolitar

overview: Born with sealed meridians and death written into his fate, Peng Dasheng was never meant to become a hero. Sent down the mountain to break off his engagement, the powerless disciple of the Wuhuduandao Sect discovers a destiny beyond imagination. With one miracle after another, he defeats six Demon Sect masters and rises to become the leader of the martial alliance. When his true identity is revealed, the hero once revered by all is cast out by the entire martial world. Only then does the soul jade awaken, unlocking the power hidden within him. Now, Peng Dasheng will defy the fate that cursed him, destroy the Demon Sect's hidden mastermind, and reshape the entire martial world before disappearing into legend with the woman he loves.
title: Young Swordsman

overview: Shy Miwa has always dreamed of finding love, but living in small-town Japan made finding the right match difficult—especially since she likes girls! Even going away to college didn't seem to help, until one day her outgoing classmate Saeko suggests they might as well start dating each other since it's not like either of them has other options. At first it seems like things won't work out as their personalities clash and misunderstandings abound. But when their casual friendship starts to become something more, Miwa begins to wonder—can a pragmatic proposal lead to true love?
title: How Do We Relationship?

overview: Guilty Creatures delves into the psyche of a torrid romance and subsequent act of murder between two young, adulterous but God-fearing lovers, unraveling their complex lives and the emotional toll of living as killers for 18 years.
title: Guilty Creatures

overview: British military historian professor Richard Holmes gives you an insight of four major battles in World War II. The battle of Cassino, El Alamein, Arnhem (Operation Market Garden) & RAF Bomber Command.
title: Battlefields

overview: This three-part documentary series explores the mysterious details surrounding the Sydney Luna Park tragedy that took seven lives in 1979.
title: Exposed: The Ghost Train Fire

overview: The adult children of a single father choose among several suitors to decide which woman will marry their dad.
title: Who Wants To Marry My Dad?

overview: A teenage girl goes missing from her home in Bristol, prompting a huge search across the city and a social media campaign to find her. As days pass fears grow that she may have come to harm. As the police investigation progresses shocking evidence is discovered, pointing towards a family member for her murder but no one could have imagined what happened next.
title: A Killer in the Family: The Murder of Becky Watts

overview: In the spring of 1959, thirteen people were stuck by a violent storm on a small islet near Mallorca. Any of them could anticipate what is about to happen at the small hotel where they're staying: Elisa Mander, a discreet British tourist, is found dead. What initially seems like a suicide soon raises unsettling signs—it may in fact be murder. Basil, a retired actor once famous for portraying none other than Sherlock Holmes on the big screen, finds himself unexpectedly tasked with unravelling the case. In a place no one can leave—and no one can reach—every guest and staff member becomes a suspect in a crime that grows more intricate and twisted by the minute.
title: El problema final

overview: Live broadcast television event. Some of the biggest names in entertainment are on hand to raise money for the fight against cancer.
title: Stand Up to Cancer

overview: Lin Xiaojia, a young amusement park mechanic, accidentally travels to a parallel universe: the Zhaoming Dynasty, an industrial superpower ruled by Mohist mechanical engineering. When Japanese onmyoji send mutated beasts to invade, the centuries-old giant Mohist mecha "Zhong Kui" is awakened by Lin. Using modern repair skills to pilot the ancient mecha, he joins the Mech Bureau to fight interdimensional beasts and conspiracies, igniting a thrilling clash between Eastern ancient machinery and modern mecha combat across time and space.
title: Macha Dynasty: Zhong Kui

overview: Four months after a night gone horribly wrong, Billie holds a gathering in honour of her dead best friend. But as the night unfolds, she realises her mates may be hiding more than they seem.
title: Please Don't Break Anything

overview: Over 3,500 years, brave voyagers cross millions of miles of harsh Pacific Ocean in handmade canoes. They find and settle thousands of islands, reaching as far as Guam, Hawaii, Rapa Nui and Fiji. Becoming master navigators, they overcome deadly natural barriers, and build an ocean world like no other - one connected by canoes and legends of the sea.
title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters

overview: Les Beaux Malaises is a show about daily situations were Martin bumps into the toughness of a family life, into the complexity of friends relationships and into the overall stupidity of our Society. And for once he's not always at it's best! Hence the awkward situations. One thing is for sure though Martin Matte is not your average John Doe!
title: Les Beaux Malaises

overview: Adam Liaw embarks on an extraordinary culinary journey across North America, celebrating how food, sport, and culture unite communities and shape national identity.
title: Adam Liaw's North American Fan Feasts

overview: Five aspiring performers compete for a coveted music industry opportunity, only to discover that their greatest strength lies in collaboration rather than rivalry. As they navigate friendship, self-doubt and the pressures of pursuing a music career, they form a band and chart their own path to stardom.
title: L.O.L. Surprise! The Next Headliner

overview: Daniel Faitaua takes the tried-and-true Tipping Point formula and infuses it with a distinctly Kiwi flavour, alongside some some of Aotearoa's favourite famous faces
title: Celebrity Tipping Point NZ

overview: Maisie and Joel experience the unpredictability of a British summer through a series of light-hearted challenges. Mystery boxes filled with quirky postcards, seasonal items, and essentials from Boots guide them through each task. Their journey takes them from festivals to seaside trips and countryside wellness retreats, where they tackle activities like capturing the perfect beach photo and cycling a tandem route. Throughout, they stay prepared for changing conditions with a range of health and beauty products suited to every setting.
title: Summer Unboxed with Maisie and Joel

overview: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab follows long-term couples whose relationships have been rocked by infidelity as they move into the Miami-based "Cheathab House" to confront the trust issues, jealousy, and unresolved wounds threatening their futures. An emotionally charged journey of accountability, difficult choices and redemption.
title: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab

overview: Bulges follows the lovably eccentric staff at an iconic and once-thriving all-male, not-so-family friendly restaurant called Bulges in Niagara Falls, Ontario, as they embrace friendship, juggle complicated love lives, and fend off ruthless cross-town rivals... all while sporting booty shorts that are tight in all the right places.
title: Bulges

overview: The series takes audiences on a high-energy journey across America's most iconic highway, combining adventure, competition, entertainment, community celebration, and philanthropy.
title: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition

overview: "Five Reasons to Visit..." is a television program that introduces the unique nature, sights, culture, and traditions of the peoples of the Commonwealth countries. Traveling with us is always exciting, because we always have "five reasons" to do so.
title: Пять причин поехать в…

overview: After a botched bank heist and a stolen cop car collide, four misfit kids sent to a dodgy youth camp find themselves standing between a crew of robbers and a million bucks.
title: Baddies

overview: Parenthood is the critically acclaimed one-hour drama inspired by the box office hit of the same name. This reimagined and updated Universal Television/Imagine Entertainment production follows the trials and tribulations of the very large, colorful and imperfect Braverman family. Sarah Braverman is a single mother with two kids - the bright but rebellious Amber who is living on her own, and sullen and sensitive Drew who returns to Berkeley this year.
title: Parenthood

overview: In the final season of The Hills - Kristin, Audrina and Heidi learn that the people they love the most can be the hardest to hold on to. Kristin has made some enemies in LA, but now that her summer romance with Justin is fading, she wants to make friends. But when Kristin ditches the girls in Miami, rumors about her partying and late nights surface. Luckily, she's got her friend Brody to stand by her. She never really let Brody off the hook, and now they're both single -- and before they know it they go from friends, to friends with benefits. But Brody isn't looking to settle down, and soon he meets a new girl. That means Kristin taking a backseat, and that means trouble for everyone. In a city full of women that he's conquered, Brody may also have his eye on someone he's never been able to get a hold of -- Audrina. Audrina finds a fresh start and a true shot at happiness when she starts dating her old friend, Ryan Cabrera. Ryan is everything that Justin isn't -- and he's ready to commit. But no matter how many times she swears him off, Justin is never really out of Audrina's life. Seeing Justin playing with his band makes her wonder if Ryan is the man she really wants. No one has changed more than Heidi. Because of her cosmetic surgeries, Heidi has to endure the disapproval of her mother and friends. As bad as that seems, what comes next for her is even harder. A year into their marriage, Spencer is more distant from his family and friends than ever before. After years of fighting for him and their relationship, Heidi has to decide if she's ready to stand by him -- for better or worse. The Hills may be coming to an end, but it's not over until it's over. The end is just beginning.
title: The Hills

overview: From Yugoslavia to Afghanistan, Iraq, Syria and Libya, Thomas 'MET' Kristensen has been involved when Denmark sent the Air Force into action. Now he is flying his last mission and looking back on a life over the world's hot spots.
title: Jagerpilotens sidste mission

overview: The Best of Us dramatizes a landmark case that reshaped the fight for accountability: a relentless legal war that stretched nearly a decade to secure almost $1 billion in compensation for first responders who fell gravely ill in the wake of 9/11.
title: The Best of Us

overview: The story of Flight 571 did not end on the day the survivors were rescued from the Andes. For them, and for the families of those who did not return, the hardest part was about to begin. Whilst silence reigned amongst those directly involved, the rest of the world continued to try to understand what had happened through books, films and documentaries. But how does one rebuild a life after such a tragedy?
title: Más allá de la sociedad

overview: I Can Grow It follows Aaron Roach Bridgeman and his young "Garden Buds" as they uncover the magic of nature in a colourful inner‑city garden, from tiny seeds to buzzing bees and harvest-time surprises. Packed with music, hands‑on fun and simple ideas to try at home, the series shows that anyone can grow something — anywhere.
title: I Can Grow It

overview: Baradun and the Dickheads return, and this time they have landed in Daggerheart! What begins as a light-hearted adventure in the Beast Feast campaign frame, filled with bizarre creatures & questionable cooking, soon reveals a much darker mystery.
title: Daggerheart: Azerim

overview: A story about love, identity, and the relationships that have no name — and no less meaning for it. Appu and Mohak have built a life together in Mumbai. When circumstances force a lavender marriage into their home, all three lives change in ways none of them planned.
